a: Up to $500K over 24-month base plus an optional 12-month $500K (Director's Fellowship)
dt: YFA 2027 call not posted yet; DARPA says the annual call usually posts in September or October. YFA 2026 executive summaries were due Oct 15, 2025
e: Current tenure-track assistant or associate professors, or tenured faculty within 3 years of tenure date, at US institutions. OPEN to US citizens, permanent residents AND foreign nationals. Excluded if prior DARPA funding exceeds $500K (or all DoD funding exceeds $1.25M).
unv: 2027 dates and eligibility not yet posted. Details are from YFA 2026.
